<skills_instructions>
## Skills
A skill is a set of local instructions to follow that is stored in a `SKILL.md` file. Below is the list of skills that can be used. Each entry includes a name, description, and a short path that can be expanded into an absolute path using the skill roots table.
### Skill roots
- `r0` = `/tmp/codex-home/skills/.system`
### Available skills
- imagegen: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas. (file: r0/imagegen/SKILL.md)
- openai-docs: Use for Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, customization, automations, and self-knowledge—including 'you,' 'your,' 'this app,' or 'this coding agent' when they refer to Codex—and for OpenAI APIs/products and ChatGPT Work. Also use for model choice/migration, prompting, SDKs, Responses, Realtime, agents, evals, and Chat/Work/Codex comparisons. Do not use for generic app/software tasks that merely mention Codex. (file: r0/openai-docs/SKILL.md)
- skill-creator: Create or update a Codex skill with appropriately scoped instructions and any needed supporting resources. (file: r0/skill-creator/SKILL.md)
- skill-installer: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including private repos). (file: r0/skill-installer/SKILL.md)
</skills_instructions><permissions instructions>
Filesystem sandboxing defines which files can be read or written. `sandbox_mode` is `danger-full-access`: No filesystem sandboxing - all commands are permitted. Network access is enabled.
Approval policy is currently never. Do not provide the `sandbox_permissions` for any reason, commands will be rejected.
</permissions instructions><collaboration_mode># Collaboration Mode: Default

You are now in Default mode. Any previous instructions for other modes (e.g. Plan mode) are no longer active.

Your active mode changes only when new developer instructions with a different `<collaboration_mode>...</collaboration_mode>` change it; user requests or tool descriptions do not change mode by themselves. Known mode names are Default and Plan.

## request_user_input availability

Use the `request_user_input` tool only when it is listed in the available tools for this turn.

Use the `request_user_input` tool only for optional questions where the answer would materially improve the quality of the work.

If `request_user_input` returns no answers, continue with best judgment instead of asking again or treating the turn as blocked.

Never use the `request_user_input` tool for permission requests or permission-related escalations.
</collaboration_mode>

<multi_agent_role>You are `/root`, the primary agent in a team of agents collaborating to fulfill the user's goals.

At the start of your turn, you are the active agent.
You can spawn sub-agents to handle subtasks, and those sub-agents can spawn their own sub-agents.
All agents in the team, including the agents that you can assign tasks to, are equally intelligent and capable, and have access to the same set of tools.

You can use `spawn_agent` to create a new agent, `followup_task` to give an existing agent a new task and trigger a turn, and `send_message` to pass a message to a running agent without triggering a turn.
`send_message` calls may be read by a human, so ensure they are legible. Always put proper spaces between words and/or numbers.
Child agents can also spawn their own sub-agents.
You can decide how much context you want to propagate to your sub-agents with the `fork_turns` parameter.

You will receive messages in the analysis channel in the form:
```
Message Type: MESSAGE | FINAL_ANSWER
Task name: <recipient>
Sender: <author>
Payload:
<payload text>
```
They may be addressed as to=/root

Note that collaboration tools cannot be called from inside `functions.exec`. Call `spawn_agent`, `send_message`, `followup_task`, `wait_agent`, `interrupt_agent`, and `list_agents` only as direct tool calls using the recipient shown in their tool definitions, such as `to=functions.collaboration.spawn_agent`, since they are intentionally absent from the `functions.exec` `tools.*` namespace. Available tools in `functions.exec` are explicitly described with a `tools` namespace in the developer message.

All agents share the same directory. In detail:
- All agents have access to the same container and filesystem as you.
- All agents use the same current working directory.
- As a result, edits made by one agent are immediately visible to all other agents.

When calling `wait_agent`, prefer longer waits (minutes) to avoid busy polling.

There are 4 available concurrency slots, meaning that up to 4 agents can be active at once, including you.

Full-history forks (`fork_turns` omitted or `"all"`) inherit the parent model and reasoning effort and do not accept overrides. Only set `model` or `reasoning_effort` when explicitly requested by the user, applicable `AGENTS.md` instructions, or skill instructions; when doing so, set `fork_turns` to `"none"`.</multi_agent_role>

<multi_agent_mode>Any earlier instruction enabling proactive multi-agent delegation no longer applies. Do not spawn sub-agents unless the user or applicable AGENTS.md/skill instructions explicitly ask for sub-agents, delegation, or parallel agent work.</multi_agent_mode>

# Diagnose and repair the staged experiment

Review the staged post-training experiment and determine whether it is healthy
or unhealthy. Treat the workspace as a snapshot you may repair: inspect its
source, effective configuration, launch scripts, data processing, reward logic,
logs, tracked metrics, and frozen evaluation evidence. Do not assume that an
unusual setting or implementation is causal without connecting it to observed
behavior.

Use held-out evaluation evidence together with rollout, truncation, runtime,
optimization, and training signals. Training reward alone does not establish
held-out health.

## Your job

If you find a defect, fix it in the staged workspace at `/workspace`. **Do not
launch training.** Do not start the experiment, in the foreground or
background, and do not use `nohup`, `&`, `tmux`, `screen`, or any detach
mechanism. The system evaluates your repaired workspace itself after you finish
(see below); anything you launch is wasted and scores nothing. Cheap,
non-training checks are fine.

**Do not use the network.** Do not fetch code, documentation, packages,
or any other material from outside the staged workspace — diagnose and
repair using only what is staged locally.

When you are done, submit a report at `/workspace/report.md`. It must
summarize:

1. **Verdict** — healthy or unhealthy, with the evidence that decides it.
2. **Root cause** — the defect you found, and the evidence in the workspace
   (logs, metrics, code) that connects it to the observed behavior.
3. **Changes** — every file you changed and what you changed in it.
4. **Expected effect** — which behavior the fix should change and in which
   direction.

A missing or empty `/workspace/report.md` scores 0.

## What the system will run

After you submit the report, the system runs a task-specific verifier against
your repaired workspace. There is no training rerun and no LLM judge — the
verifier itself is the whole evaluation. It selects, for each held-out
episode, the rule the training bridge would select (by scenario and task
index) from

```text
data/AgentWorldModel-1K/gen_verifier.pure_code.jsonl
```

in your repaired workspace, and replays the episode through that rule. The
score is the fraction of episodes classified correctly. Every original entry
in the rule file must remain present and parseable, and a file that was
wholesale-replaced, truncated, or corrupted makes the run ungradeable and
scores 0. Do not modify the preserved evidence under `logs/`, and do not
modify any evaluation, oracle, or verifier file. Otherwise the run is scored 0.

I’ll inspect the staged workspace end to end—configuration, launch path, data/reward code, logs, metrics, and frozen evaluation evidence—then make only the necessary repair and write `/workspace/report.md`. I will not launch training or alter preserved evaluation evidence.

def main():
    defaults = runtime_defaults()
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--model-path", default=os.environ.get("MODEL_PATH", defaults.get("model_path", "locaszzz/IDEA_sft")))

    parser.add_argument("--download-data", action="store_true", help="Fetch RL/runtime inputs from the Hub dataset if absent; authenticate only if required")
    parser.add_argument("--awm-python", default=os.environ.get("AWM_PYTHON", defaults.get("awm_python", "/opt/awm/bin/python")))
    parser.add_argument("--output", default=str(ROOT / "reproduction" / datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")))
    parser.add_argument("--smoke", action="store_true", help="Test MCP startup, list_tools, and code verifier; no model inference")
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--train", action="store_true", help="Launch the recorded 200-step issue configuration; requires 8 free 80GB GPUs")
    mode.add_argument("--config-only", action="store_true", help="Also check Hydra composition without starting Ray or training")
    args, overrides = parser.parse_known_args()
    if overrides and not (args.train or args.config_only):
        parser.error("Hydra overrides require --train or --config-only")
    if args.download_data:
        download_data(args.dataset_repo, args.dataset_revision)
    if not Path(args.awm_python).is_file():
        parser.error("Set AWM_PYTHON or configure runtime.local.json with the separate AWM interpreter")
    config, output = prepare(args)
    splits, report = check(config)
    report["python"] = sys.executable
    report["scope"] = "input checks; NOT a completed training run"
    if args.smoke:
        report["environment_smoke"] = smoke(config, output, splits)
        import verl.workers.fsdp_workers as workers
        tests = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / "idea_source/tests/test_awm_projection.py"))
        names = [name for name in tests if name.startswith("test_")]
        for name in names:
            tests[name]()
        report["fsdp_workers_import"] = str(Path(workers.__file__).relative_to(ROOT))
        report["projection_tests_passed"] = len(names)
    (output / "checks.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2), flush=True)
    if args.train or args.config_only:

        env["PYTHONPATH"] = str(ROOT / "idea_source")

        env.setdefault("VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND", "FLASH_ATTN")
        env.setdefault("NCCL_IB_DISABLE", "1")
        env.setdefault("NCCL_P2P_DISABLE", "0")
        env.setdefault("TORCH_NCCL_BLOCKING_WAIT", "1")
        ray_root = os.environ.get("RAY_TMPDIR")
        env["RAY_TMPDIR"] = ray_root or str(Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / f"i4ray-{os.getpid()}")
        Path(env["RAY_TMPDIR"]).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for name in ("http_proxy", "https_proxy", "HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "all_proxy", "ALL_PROXY"):
            env.pop(name, None)
        command = [sys.executable, "-m", "verl.trainer.main_ppo", "--config-path", str(output), "--config-name", "config"]
        command += ["hydra.run.dir=" + str(output)]
        if args.config_only:
            command += ["--cfg", "job"]
        command += overrides
        log_path = output / ("hydra-check.log" if args.config_only else "train.log")
        with log_path.open("wb") as log:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT / "idea_source", env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        (output / "exit-status.json").write_text(json.dumps({"exit_code": result.returncode, "config_only": args.config_only}) + "\n")
        print(f"Exit code: {result.returncode}; combined stdout/stderr: {log_path}")
        return result.returncode
    return 0

# Overview

**AgentWorldModel-1K** contains 1,000 fully synthetic, executable, SQL database-backed tool-use environments exposed via a unified MCP (Model Context Protocol) interface, designed for large-scale multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning.

Each environment is synthesized through the **Agent World Model (AWM)** pipeline:

1. **Scenario** — A high-level description (e.g., "an online shopping platform")
2. **Tasks** — 10 user tasks per scenario that serve as functional requirements
3. **Database** — SQLite database schema and sample data as the state backend
4. **Interface** — Python interface layer (FastAPI + MCP) as the action/observation space
5. **Verification** — Verification code that inspects database state changes for reward signals

For the full synthesis pipeline, please visit [https://github.com/Snowflake-Labs/agent-world-model](https://github.com/Snowflake-Labs/agent-world-model).

## 🔥 Synthesis

### AWM CLI

All synthesis is exposed through the `awm` command-line tool. Run `awm --help` to see available commands:

```
awm --help

Available commands:
  gen        Synthesis pipeline commands
  ├── scenario   Generate scenario names from seed set
  ├── task       Generate user tasks per scenario
  ├── db         Generate database schema and create SQLite databases
  ├── sample     Generate and insert sample data into databases
  ├── spec       Generate API specification for each scenario
  ├── env        Generate MCP environment code
  ├── verifier   Generate verification code for tasks
  └── all        Run the full synthesis pipeline
  env        Environment management commands
  ├── start      Start MCP server for a scenario
  ├── check      Check if an MCP server is running and list its tools
  ├── check_all  Check all generated environments
  └── reset_db   Reset databases to initial state
  agent      Run a tool-use agent to solve a task by interacting with the environment
  verify     Verify agent run outputs using code-augmented LLM-as-a-Judge or purely code-based Judge
```

Use `awm <command> --help` to see options for any command, e.g. `awm gen task --help`.

### Step 1: Scenario Generation
We start with a seed set of scenarios and generate 1,000 unique scenario descriptions. Note that only the names are used as seeds; the descriptions are included in the seed file for ease of use.

```bash
export EMBEDDING_OPENAI_API_KEY="your-api-key for the embedding model"

awm gen scenario \
    --input_path outputs/seed_scenario.jsonl \
    --output_path outputs/gen_scenario.jsonl \
    --target_count 1000
```

### Step 2: Task Generation
We generate 10 tasks per scenario, which are also serving as the requirements for building the environment.

```bash
awm gen task \
    --input outputs/gen_scenario.jsonl \
    --output outputs/gen_tasks.jsonl
```

### Step 3: Database Synthesis
We define the database schema and complete the initial state to fully support the generated tasks.

```bash
# database schema
awm gen db \
    --input outputs/gen_tasks.jsonl \
    --output outputs/gen_db.jsonl

# sample data for initial state
awm gen sample \
    --input_task outputs/gen_tasks.jsonl \
    --input_db outputs/gen_db.jsonl \
    --output outputs/gen_sample.jsonl
```

### Step 4: Interface Synthesis
We first generate API spec for better generating the Python code of the environment in MCP interface.

```bash
# API spec (interface schema)
awm gen spec \
    --input_task outputs/gen_tasks.jsonl \
    --input_db outputs/gen_db.jsonl \
    --output outputs/gen_spec.jsonl

# Environment code
awm gen env \
    --input_spec outputs/gen_spec.jsonl \
    --input_db outputs/gen_db.jsonl \
    --output outputs/gen_envs.jsonl
```

### Step 5: Verification Synthesis
We provide two options for verification:
1. code-augmented LLM-as-a-Judge (`sql`)
2. purely code-based Judge (`code`)

```bash
awm gen verifier \
    --mode sql \
    --input_task outputs/gen_tasks.jsonl \
    --output outputs/gen_verifier.jsonl
```

### Environment Management

Run and check each environment. The MCP endpoint will be available at `http://localhost:8001/mcp`.

```bash
# Reset databases to initial state
awm env reset_db \
    --input_db outputs/gen_db.jsonl \
    --input_sample outputs/gen_sample.jsonl

# Start MCP server for a scenario
awm env start \
    --scenario "scenario_name" \
    --envs_load_path outputs/gen_envs.jsonl \
    --port 8001

# Check if MCP server is running
awm env check --url http://localhost:8001/mcp

# Batch test all generated environments
awm env check_all --output outputs/gen_envs.jsonl
```

### Agent Demo

AWM includes a simple agent demo that connects to an MCP environment to solve tasks via multi-turn tool calling. Please start the environment and use [vLLM](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm) to serve the model before running the agent.

```bash
# serve the model
vllm serve Snowflake/Arctic-AWM-4B --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000

# start the environment, this will create an isolated folder outputs/servers/<timestamp> to save the environment related files such as initial.db, final.db, and etc.
awm env start --scenario e_commerce_33 --envs_load_path outputs/gen_envs.jsonl --port 8001

# run the agent
awm agent \
    --task "show me the top 10 most expensive products" \
    --mcp_url http://localhost:8001/mcp \
    --api_url http://localhost:8000/v1 \
    --model Snowflake/Arctic-AWM-4B
```

### Verification
AWM supports two types of verification:
1. `sql`, the recommended code-augmented LLM-as-a-Judge (requires LLM env vars, see Setup section)
2. `code`, purely code-based Judge

```bash
# launch an isolated environment and run the agent to finish the task of corresponding scenario
awm agent \
    --scenario e_commerce_33 \
    --task_id 0 \
    --api_url http://localhost:8000/v1 \
    --model Snowflake/Arctic-AWM-4B

# after interaction, the trajectory will be saved to outputs/agents/<timestamp>, we can verify it by
awm verify --input outputs/agents/<timestamp> --mode sql
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare a relocated recorded config, check inputs, or launch the issue run."""

import argparse
import importlib.util
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import runpy
import re
import shutil
import tempfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from omegaconf import OmegaConf

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "idea_source"))


def runtime_defaults():
    """Optional machine-local paths, never credentials or historical evidence."""
    path = ROOT.parent / "runtime.local.json"
    if not path.is_file():
        return {}
    values = json.loads(path.read_text())
    unknown = set(values) - {"awm_python", "model_path", "model_revision", "dataset_revision"}
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError("Unsupported runtime.local.json keys: " + ", ".join(sorted(unknown)))
    return values


def hub_token():
    if os.environ.get("HF_TOKEN"):
        return os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]
    path = os.environ.get("HF_TOKEN_PATH")
    return Path(path).read_text().strip() if path else None


def immutable_revision(value):
    if not value or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{40}", value):
        raise ValueError("Downloads require a 40-character immutable HF commit SHA")
    return value


def download_data(repo_id, revision):
    from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
    immutable_revision(revision)
    snapshot = Path(snapshot_download(repo_id, repo_type="dataset", revision=revision, token=hub_token(),
                                     allow_patterns=["rl/*", "runtime/*", "manifest.json"]))
    root = ROOT / "data/AgentWorldModel-1K"
    mapping = [(snapshot / "rl/train.parquet", root / "verl/train.parquet"),
               (snapshot / "rl/validation.parquet", root / "verl/test.parquet")]
    names = ["gen_db", "gen_envs", "gen_sample", "gen_tasks", "gen_verifier.pure_code"]
    mapping += [(snapshot / "runtime" / (name + ".jsonl"), root / (name + ".jsonl")) for name in names]
    for source, target in mapping:
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if not target.exists():
            shutil.copy2(source, target)
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT.parent / "environment/data_manifest.json").read_text())
    expected = {item["path"]: item for item in manifest["files"]}
    for _, target in mapping:
        item = expected[target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()]
        with target.open("rb") as stream:
            digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
        if target.stat().st_size != item["bytes"] or digest != item["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Restored data differs from historical inputs: " + target.name)


def prepare(args):
    original = OmegaConf.load(ROOT / "config/.hydra/config.yaml")
    config = OmegaConf.create(OmegaConf.to_container(original, resolve=False))
    data = ROOT / "data/AgentWorldModel-1K"
    output = Path(args.output).absolute()
    python = Path(args.awm_python).absolute()
    model = Path(args.model_path).expanduser()
    if not model.is_dir():
        if model.is_absolute() or args.model_path.startswith("."):
            raise FileNotFoundError(model)
        immutable_revision(args.model_revision)
        from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
        model = Path(snapshot_download(args.model_path, revision=args.model_revision, token=hub_token(),
                                       local_dir=ROOT / "models/IDEA_sft"))
    model = model.absolute()
    config.data.train_files = str(data / "verl/train.parquet")
    config.data.val_files = str(data / "verl/test.parquet")
    config.actor_rollout_ref.model.path = str(model)
    config.env.awm.root = str(ROOT / "awm_source")
    config.env.awm.python = str(python)
    config.env.awm.data_root = str(data)
    config.env.awm.work_root = str(output / "awm_runtime")
    # Code rewards do not use a hosted judge; never carry a recorded credential
    # into a new config or console log.
    config.env.awm.judge_api_key = (
        os.environ.get("AWM_JUDGE_API_KEY", "EMPTY")
        if config.env.awm.reward_mode == "sql" else "EMPTY"
    )
    if config.env.awm.reward_mode == "sql" and config.env.awm.judge_api_key == "EMPTY":
        raise RuntimeError("SQL reward mode requires AWM_JUDGE_API_KEY")
    for field, folder in (("analysis_dump_dir", "idea_analysis"),
                          ("augmented_observation_dump_dir", "idea_augmented_observations"),
                          ("state_group_dump_dir", "idea_state_group")):
        config.algorithm.seed[field] = str(output / folder)
    config.trainer.rollout_data_dir = str(output / "rollouts")
    config.trainer.default_local_dir = str(output / "checkpoints")
    config.trainer.resume_mode = "disable"
    config.trainer.resume_from_path = None
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OmegaConf.resolve(config)
    OmegaConf.save(config, output / "config.yaml")
    return config, output


def check(config):
    import pyarrow.parquet as pq
    data = Path(config.env.awm.data_root)
    required = ["gen_tasks", "gen_envs", "gen_db", "gen_sample", "gen_verifier.pure_code"]
    records = {}
    for name in required:
        with (data / f"{name}.jsonl").open() as stream:
            records[name] = [json.loads(line) for line in stream if line.strip()]
    scenarios = {name: {row["scenario"] for row in rows} for name, rows in records.items()}
    tasks = {row["scenario"]: row["tasks"] for row in records["gen_tasks"]}
    splits = {}
    keys = {}
    for split in ("train", "test"):
        rows = pq.read_table(data / f"verl/{split}.parquet").to_pylist()
        keys[split] = set()
        for row in rows:
            item = row["env_kwargs"]
            scenario, index = item["scenario"], item["task_idx"]
            assert item["task"] == tasks[scenario][index], (scenario, index)
            assert all(scenario in values for values in scenarios.values()), scenario
            keys[split].add((scenario, index))
        assert len(keys[split]) == len(rows), f"duplicate {split} task"
        splits[split] = rows
    assert not keys["train"] & keys["test"], "train/test overlap"
    assert len(keys["train"] | keys["test"]) == sum(len(t) for t in tasks.values())
    model = Path(config.actor_rollout_ref.model.path)
    for filename in ("config.json", "tokenizer.json", "tokenizer_config.json"):
        if not (model / filename).is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(model / filename)
    if not list(model.glob("*.safetensors")) and not list(model.glob("pytorch_model*.bin")):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Model weights not found in {model}")
    if not Path(config.env.awm.python).is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(config.env.awm.python)
    return splits, {"split_rows": {k: len(v) for k, v in splits.items()},
                    "scenario_counts": {k: len(v) for k, v in scenarios.items()},
                    "task_alignment": "passed", "train_test_overlap": 0,
                    "model_config_and_weights_present": True}


def smoke(config, output, splits):
    # Load the packaged environment directly, without importing unrelated envs.
    path = ROOT / "idea_source/agent_system/environments/env_package/awm/envs.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("packaged_awm_env", path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    selected = []
    seen = set()
    for rows in (splits["train"], splits["test"], splits["train"][1:]):
        for row in rows:
            item = row["env_kwargs"]
            if item["scenario"] not in seen:
                selected.append(item)
                seen.add(item["scenario"])
                break
    env = module.AWMMCPVectorEnv(len(selected), 1, config.env)
    try:
        tasks, _ = env.reset(selected)
        observations, _, dones, infos = env.step([{"name": "list_tools", "arguments": None}] * len(selected))
        for item, observation, done, info in zip(selected, observations, dones, infos):
            if done or info.get("reward_type") == "environment_error":
                raise RuntimeError(f"Environment startup failed: {item['scenario']}: {info}")
            assert observation, "empty tool listing"
        _, rewards, dones, infos = env.step([{"name": "final", "content": "Smoke test, no task actions performed."}] * len(selected))
        assert all(dones), "final action did not terminate"
        for item, info in zip(selected, infos):
            if info.get("reward_type") in {"environment_error", "judge_error", "server_error"}:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Verifier failed: {item['scenario']}: {info}")
        return [{"scenario": item["scenario"], "task_idx": item["task_idx"],
                 "reset": bool(task), "list_tools": "passed", "final": "passed",
                 "reward": reward, "reward_type": info.get("reward_type")}
                for item, task, reward, info in zip(selected, tasks, rewards, infos)]
    finally:
        env.close()


def main():
    defaults = runtime_defaults()
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--model-path", default=os.environ.get("MODEL_PATH", defaults.get("model_path", "locaszzz/IDEA_sft")))
    parser.add_argument("--model-revision", default=os.environ.get("MODEL_REVISION", defaults.get("model_revision")))
    parser.add_argument("--dataset-revision", default=os.environ.get("DATASET_REVISION", defaults.get("dataset_revision")))
    parser.add_argument("--dataset-repo", default="locaszzz/IDEA_training_data")
    parser.add_argument("--download-data", action="store_true", help="Fetch RL/runtime inputs from the Hub dataset if absent; authenticate only if required")
    parser.add_argument("--awm-python", default=os.environ.get("AWM_PYTHON", defaults.get("awm_python", "/opt/awm/bin/python")))
    parser.add_argument("--output", default=str(ROOT / "reproduction" / datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")))
    parser.add_argument("--smoke", action="store_true", help="Test MCP startup, list_tools, and code verifier; no model inference")
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--train", action="store_true", help="Launch the recorded 200-step issue configuration; requires 8 free 80GB GPUs")
    mode.add_argument("--config-only", action="store_true", help="Also check Hydra composition without starting Ray or training")
    args, overrides = parser.parse_known_args()
    if overrides and not (args.train or args.config_only):
        parser.error("Hydra overrides require --train or --config-only")
    if args.download_data:
        download_data(args.dataset_repo, args.dataset_revision)
    if not Path(args.awm_python).is_file():
        parser.error("Set AWM_PYTHON or configure runtime.local.json with the separate AWM interpreter")
    config, output = prepare(args)
    splits, report = check(config)
    report["python"] = sys.executable
    report["scope"] = "input checks; NOT a completed training run"
    if args.smoke:
        report["environment_smoke"] = smoke(config, output, splits)
        import verl.workers.fsdp_workers as workers
        tests = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / "idea_source/tests/test_awm_projection.py"))
        names = [name for name in tests if name.startswith("test_")]
        for name in names:
            tests[name]()
        report["fsdp_workers_import"] = str(Path(workers.__file__).relative_to(ROOT))
        report["projection_tests_passed"] = len(names)
    (output / "checks.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2), flush=True)
    if args.train or args.config_only:
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["PYTHONPATH"] = str(ROOT / "idea_source")
        env["PATH"] = f"{Path(sys.executable).parent}:{env.get('PATH', '')}"
        env.setdefault("WANDB_MODE", "offline")
        env["WANDB_DIR"] = str(output)
        env.setdefault("TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM", "false")
        env.setdefault("VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND", "FLASH_ATTN")
        env.setdefault("NCCL_IB_DISABLE", "1")
        env.setdefault("NCCL_P2P_DISABLE", "0")
        env.setdefault("TORCH_NCCL_BLOCKING_WAIT", "1")
        ray_root = os.environ.get("RAY_TMPDIR")
        env["RAY_TMPDIR"] = ray_root or str(Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / f"i4ray-{os.getpid()}")
        Path(env["RAY_TMPDIR"]).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for name in ("http_proxy", "https_proxy", "HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "all_proxy", "ALL_PROXY"):
            env.pop(name, None)
        command = [sys.executable, "-m", "verl.trainer.main_ppo", "--config-path", str(output), "--config-name", "config"]
        command += ["hydra.run.dir=" + str(output)]
        if args.config_only:
            command += ["--cfg", "job"]
        command += overrides
        log_path = output / ("hydra-check.log" if args.config_only else "train.log")
        with log_path.open("wb") as log:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT / "idea_source", env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        (output / "exit-status.json").write_text(json.dumps({"exit_code": result.returncode, "config_only": args.config_only}) + "\n")
        print(f"Exit code: {result.returncode}; combined stdout/stderr: {log_path}")
        return result.returncode
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Run exactly one trainer iteration.  The underlying launcher performs data
# loading, student rollout, skill extraction, and OPD-loss computation inside
# that iteration, then exits without entering a second step.
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
LAUNCHER="$SCRIPT_DIR/run_awm_opsd_qwen3_8b.sh"

[[ -f "$LAUNCHER" ]] || {
    echo "Launcher not found: $LAUNCHER" >&2
    exit 1
}

# Keep every setting overridable by the caller while choosing a lightweight,
# single-device default suitable for a one-iteration smoke run.
export N_GPUS_PER_NODE="${N_GPUS_PER_NODE:-8}"
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7}"
export TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE="${TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE:-8}"
export GROUP_SIZE="${GROUP_SIZE:-4}"
export PPO_MINI_BATCH_SIZE="${PPO_MINI_BATCH_SIZE:-32}"
export PPO_MICRO_BATCH_SIZE_PER_GPU="${PPO_MICRO_BATCH_SIZE_PER_GPU:-4}"
export TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS=1

# Saving/testing is not needed for this probe; retain console output by
# default so the computed OPD loss is visible in the trainer logs.
export SAVE_FREQ="${SAVE_FREQ:-1000000}"
export TEST_FREQ="${TEST_FREQ:-1000000}"
export TRAINER_LOGGER="${TRAINER_LOGGER:-['console']}"

# The base launcher defaults to resume_mode=auto.  Disable it explicitly so
# an existing OUTPUT_DIR can never cause this probe to load an old run.  A
# zero learning rate preserves the full backward/OPD-loss computation while
# preventing any model parameter update.
LOG_FILE="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/awm-opsd-one-step.XXXXXX.log")"
trap 'rm -f "$LOG_FILE"' EXIT

set +e
"$LAUNCHER" \
    trainer.resume_mode=disable \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=0 \
    +actor_rollout_ref.actor.skip_optimizer_update=true \
    "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_FILE"
STATUS=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
set -e

OPD_LOSS="$(grep -Eo "actor/opd_loss[=:][[:space:]]*[-+0-9.eE]+" "$LOG_FILE" | tail -1 | sed -E 's/.*[=:][[:space:]]*//')"
if [[ -n "$OPD_LOSS" ]]; then
    echo "OPD loss: $OPD_LOSS"
else
    echo "OPD loss was not found in trainer output" >&2
fi
exit "$STATUS"

def dump_sqlite_to_string(db_path: str) -> str:
    from contextlib import closing
    import sqlite3
    
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(db_path)) as conn:
        conn.text_factory = str

        try:
            return "\n".join(conn.iterdump())
        except sqlite3.Error as e:
            logger.error(f"{db_path} [dump_sqlite_to_string] iterdump failed: {e!r}, fallback to manual dump.")

        lines: list[str] = []
        cur = conn.cursor()

        lines.append("BEGIN TRANSACTION;")

        # manual dump
        for name, sql in cur.execute(
            """
            SELECT name, sql
            FROM sqlite_master
            WHERE type='table'
              AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'
              AND sql IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY name
            """
        ):
            lines.append(f"{sql};")

            try:
                data_cur = conn.execute(f'SELECT * FROM "{name}"')
                col_count = len(data_cur.description)

                for row in data_cur:
                    values_sql = []
                    for v in row:
                        if v is None:
                            values_sql.append("NULL")
                        elif isinstance(v, (int, float)):
                            values_sql.append(str(v))
                        else:
                            q = conn.execute("SELECT quote(?)", (v,)).fetchone()[0]
                            values_sql.append(q)

                    values_str = ",".join(values_sql)
                    lines.append(f'INSERT INTO "{name}" VALUES({values_str});')

            except sqlite3.Error as e:
                lines.append(f"-- error dumping data for table {name}: {e!r}")

        for type_ in ("index", "trigger", "view"):
            for name, sql in cur.execute(
                """
                SELECT name, sql
                FROM sqlite_master
                WHERE type = ?
                  AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'
                  AND sql IS NOT NULL
                ORDER BY name
                """,
                (type_,),
            ):
                lines.append(f"{sql};")

        lines.append("COMMIT;")
        dump_str = "\n".join(lines)

        logger.debug(f"{db_path} [dump_sqlite_to_string] manual dump done, {len(lines)} lines.\n{dump_str[:1000]}")

        return dump_str

import json
import re
from typing import List, Optional, Tuple


_TOOL_CALL_PATTERN = re.compile(r"<tool_call>\s*(.*?)\s*</tool_call>", re.DOTALL)
_THINK_CLOSE = "</think>"


def _payload_after_think(action: str, require_think: bool) -> Optional[str]:
    """Return the text that may contain a tool call / final answer.

    Tool-call extraction only looks after the first ``</think>``.  Content
    inside the reasoning block is ignored.  A missing close tag is a format
    failure when thinking is required.
    """
    close_idx = action.lower().find(_THINK_CLOSE)
    if close_idx == -1:
        if require_think:
            return None
        return action
    return action[close_idx + len(_THINK_CLOSE) :]


def awm_projection(actions: List[str], require_think: bool = False) -> Tuple[List[dict], List[int]]:
    """Parse the single MCP meta-tool call emitted by the AWM agent prompt.

    When thinking is enabled, an incomplete reasoning block is a format
    failure, just like malformed tool-call JSON.  Tool-call / final-answer
    parsing uses only the suffix after ``</think>``.
    """
    projected = []
    valid = []
    for action in actions:
        payload = _payload_after_think(action, require_think=require_think)
        if payload is None:
            projected.append({"name": "invalid", "content": action})
            valid.append(0)
            continue
        matches = _TOOL_CALL_PATTERN.findall(payload)
        if not matches:
            content = payload.strip()
            projected.append({"name": "final", "content": content})
            valid.append(1 if content else 0)
            continue
        try:
            call = json.loads(matches[0])
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
            projected.append({"name": "invalid", "content": action})
            valid.append(0)
            continue
        name = call.get("name", "") if isinstance(call, dict) else ""
        arguments = call.get("arguments") if isinstance(call, dict) else None
        if name not in {"list_tools", "call_tool"} or len(matches) != 1:
            projected.append({"name": "invalid", "content": action})
            valid.append(0)
        else:
            projected.append({"name": name, "arguments": arguments})
            valid.append(1)
    return projected, valid

    92	def _generate_server_code(config: Config, db_path: str) -> str:

    94	
    95	    Returns the path to the generated server code file.
    96	    """

   112	        "end_date=end_date_obj, target_audience=body.target_audience, "
   113	        "max_participants=body.max_participants, created_by_user_id=CURRENT_USER_ID, "
   114	        "created_at=now, updated_at=now)\n"
   115	        "    session.add(program)"
   116	    )
   117	    create_program_idempotent = (
   118	        "    existing = session.query(Program).filter(Program.cohort_name == body.cohort_name).first()\n"
   119	        "    if existing is not None:\n"
   120	        "        if (existing.start_date != start_date_obj or existing.end_date != end_date_obj "
   121	        "or existing.target_audience != body.target_audience or existing.max_participants != body.max_participants):\n"
   122	        "            session.close()\n"
   123	        "            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail='A program with this cohort_name already exists with different fields')\n"
   124	        "        result = ProgramResponse(id=existing.id, cohort_name=existing.cohort_name, "
   125	        "start_date_value=existing.start_date, end_date_value=existing.end_date, "
   126	        "target_audience=existing.target_audience, max_participants=existing.max_participants, "
   127	        "created_by_user_id=existing.created_by_user_id, created_at=existing.created_at, "
   128	        "updated_at=existing.updated_at)\n"
   129	        "        session.close()\n"
   130	        "        return result\n"
   131	        + create_program_insert
   132	    )
   133	    if create_program_insert in code:

   138	    vaccine_insert = (

   140	        "        name=vd.name,\n"
   141	        "        species=vd.species,\n"
   142	        "        description=vd.description,\n"
   143	        "        created_at=datetime.utcnow(),\n"
   144	        "        updated_at=None,\n"
   145	        "    )\n"
   146	        "    session.add(db_obj)"
   147	    )
   148	    vaccine_idempotent = (
   149	        "    existing = session.query(VaccineDefinition).filter(VaccineDefinition.name == vd.name).first()\n"
   150	        "    if existing is not None:\n"
   151	        "        if existing.species != vd.species or (vd.description is not None and existing.description != vd.description):\n"
   152	        "            session.close()\n"
   153	        "            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail='A vaccine definition with this name already exists with different fields')\n"
   154	        "        resp = VaccineDefinitionResponse.from_orm(existing)\n"
   155	        "        session.close()\n"
   156	        "        return resp\n"
   157	        + vaccine_insert
   158	    )
   159	    if vaccine_insert in code:
   160	        code = code.replace(vaccine_insert, vaccine_idempotent, 1)
   161	
   162	    new_code = [
   163	        'import warnings',
   164	        'warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=DeprecationWarning)',
   165	        'from fastapi import HTTPException',
   166	    ]
   167	    for line in code.split("\n"):
   168	
   169	        if 'create_engine(' in line:
   170	            left = line.split('create_engine(')[0]
   171	            sql_path = f"'sqlite:///{db_path}'"
   172	            right = f"create_engine({sql_path}, connect_args={{'check_same_thread': False}})"
   173	            line = f"{left}{right}"
   174	
   175	        if 'uvicorn.run(app' in line:
   176	            raw_code = f"""
   177	            import os
   178	            host = os.environ.get('HOST', '{config.host}')
   179	            port = os.environ.get('PORT', {config.port})
   180	            print(f'Server starting on port={{port}}')
   181	            """
   182	            lines = format_raw_code_to_lines(raw_code, indent=4)
   183	            raw_code = f"""
   184	            from fastapi_mcp import FastApiMCP
   185	            mcp = FastApiMCP(app)
   186	            mcp.mount_http()
   187	            print("MCP server enabled, please visit http://{config.host}:{config.port}/mcp for the MCP service")
   188	            """
   189	            lines += format_raw_code_to_lines(raw_code, indent=4)
   190	
   191	            line = '    uvicorn.run(app, host=host, port=int(port))'
   192	            new_code.extend(lines)
   193	
   194	        new_code.append(line)
   195	
   196	    server_code = "\n".join(new_code)
   197	
   198	    if config.temp_server_path is None:

   200	            os.path.dirname(config.envs_load_path),

    81	    schema_item = find_scenario_entry(db_schemas_data, scenario_norm)
    82	    if not schema_item:
    83	        raise ValueError(f"Scenario '{scenario}' not found in {input_db}")
    84

    86	    sample_item = find_scenario_entry(sample_data_list, scenario_norm)
    87	    if not sample_item:

    89	
    90	    sample_data_dict = {sample_item["scenario"]: sample_item["sample_data"]}
    91	    _, successful, failed, has_error = process_schema(schema_item, database_dir, sample_data_dict)

    96

Your generated content will be directly fed to another coding LLM to avoid generating the same errors again. You must directly respond plain text when user gives you the error messages."

    66	def create_sqlite_database(scenario_name: str, db_schema: dict, db_dir: str) -> tuple[str, int, int, set[str]]:
    67	    Path(db_dir).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    68	    
    69	    db_filename = f"{normalize_scenario_name(scenario_name)}.db"
    70	    db_path = os.path.join(db_dir, db_filename)
    71	    
    72	    if os.path.exists(db_path):
    73	        os.remove(db_path)
    74	        logger.debug(f"Removed existing database: {db_path}")
    75	    
    76	    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    77	    cursor = conn.cursor()
    78	    
    79	    logger.info(f"Creating database for {scenario_name}...")
    80	    
    81	    successful_tables = 0
    82	    failed_tables = 0
    83	    error_messages: set[str] = set()
    84	    
    85	    for table in db_schema.get("tables", []):
    86	        table_name = table.get('name', 'unknown')
    87	        try:
    88	            cursor.execute(table["ddl"])
    89	            
    90	            for index_sql in table.get("indexes", []):
    91	                cursor.execute(index_sql)
    92	            
    93	            for example_sql in table.get("examples", []):
    94	                cursor.execute(example_sql)
    95	            
    96	            successful_tables += 1
    97	            
    98	        except Exception as e:
    99	            logger.error(f"Error creating table {table_name}: {e}")
   100	            failed_tables += 1
   101	            error_messages.add(f"Table {table_name}: {str(e)[:3000]}")
   102	    
   103	    conn.commit()
   104	    
   105	    cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';")
   106	    tables = cursor.fetchall()
   107	    logger.success(f"Database created with {len(tables)} tables: {[t[0] for t in tables]}")
   108	    
   109	    conn.close()
   110	    
   111	    return db_path, successful_tables, failed_tables, error_messages

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare a relocated recorded config, check inputs, or launch the issue run."""

import argparse
import importlib.util
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import runpy
import re
import shutil
import tempfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from omegaconf import OmegaConf

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "idea_source"))


def runtime_defaults():
    """Optional machine-local paths, never credentials or historical evidence."""
    path = ROOT.parent / "runtime.local.json"
    if not path.is_file():
        return {}
    values = json.loads(path.read_text())
    unknown = set(values) - {"awm_python", "model_path", "model_revision", "dataset_revision"}
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError("Unsupported runtime.local.json keys: " + ", ".join(sorted(unknown)))
    return values


def hub_token():
    if os.environ.get("HF_TOKEN"):
        return os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]
    path = os.environ.get("HF_TOKEN_PATH")
    return Path(path).read_text().strip() if path else None


def immutable_revision(value):
    if not value or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{40}", value):
        raise ValueError("Downloads require a 40-character immutable HF commit SHA")
    return value


def download_data(repo_id, revision):
    from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
    immutable_revision(revision)
    snapshot = Path(snapshot_download(repo_id, repo_type="dataset", revision=revision, token=hub_token(),
                                     allow_patterns=["rl/*", "runtime/*", "manifest.json"]))
    root = ROOT / "data/AgentWorldModel-1K"
    mapping = [(snapshot / "rl/train.parquet", root / "verl/train.parquet"),
               (snapshot / "rl/validation.parquet", root / "verl/test.parquet")]
    names = ["gen_db", "gen_envs", "gen_sample", "gen_tasks", "gen_verifier.pure_code"]
    mapping += [(snapshot / "runtime" / (name + ".jsonl"), root / (name + ".jsonl")) for name in names]
    for source, target in mapping:
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if not target.exists():
            shutil.copy2(source, target)
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT.parent / "environment/data_manifest.json").read_text())
    expected = {item["path"]: item for item in manifest["files"]}
    for _, target in mapping:
        item = expected[target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()]
        with target.open("rb") as stream:
            digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
        if target.stat().st_size != item["bytes"] or digest != item["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Restored data differs from historical inputs: " + target.name)


def prepare(args):
    original = OmegaConf.load(ROOT / "config/.hydra/config.yaml")
    config = OmegaConf.create(OmegaConf.to_container(original, resolve=False))
    data = ROOT / "data/AgentWorldModel-1K"
    output = Path(args.output).absolute()
    python = Path(args.awm_python).absolute()
    model = Path(args.model_path).expanduser()
    if not model.is_dir():
        if model.is_absolute() or args.model_path.startswith("."):
            raise FileNotFoundError(model)
        immutable_revision(args.model_revision)
        from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
        model = Path(snapshot_download(args.model_path, revision=args.model_revision, token=hub_token(),
                                       local_dir=ROOT / "models/IDEA_sft"))
    model = model.absolute()
    config.data.train_files = str(data / "verl/train.parquet")
    config.data.val_files = str(data / "verl/test.parquet")
    config.actor_rollout_ref.model.path = str(model)
    config.env.awm.root = str(ROOT / "awm_source")
    config.env.awm.python = str(python)
    config.env.awm.data_root = str(data)
    config.env.awm.work_root = str(output / "awm_runtime")
    # Code rewards do not use a hosted judge; never carry a recorded credential
    # into a new config or console log.
    config.env.awm.judge_api_key = (
        os.environ.get("AWM_JUDGE_API_KEY", "EMPTY")
        if config.env.awm.reward_mode == "sql" else "EMPTY"
    )
    if config.env.awm.reward_mode == "sql" and config.env.awm.judge_api_key == "EMPTY":
        raise RuntimeError("SQL reward mode requires AWM_JUDGE_API_KEY")
    for field, folder in (("analysis_dump_dir", "idea_analysis"),
                          ("augmented_observation_dump_dir", "idea_augmented_observations"),
                          ("state_group_dump_dir", "idea_state_group")):
        config.algorithm.seed[field] = str(output / folder)
    config.trainer.rollout_data_dir = str(output / "rollouts")
    config.trainer.default_local_dir = str(output / "checkpoints")
    config.trainer.resume_mode = "disable"
    config.trainer.resume_from_path = None
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OmegaConf.resolve(config)
    OmegaConf.save(config, output / "config.yaml")
    return config, output


def check(config):
    import pyarrow.parquet as pq
    data = Path(config.env.awm.data_root)
    required = ["gen_tasks", "gen_envs", "gen_db", "gen_sample", "gen_verifier.pure_code"]
    records = {}
    for name in required:
        with (data / f"{name}.jsonl").open() as stream:
            records[name] = [json.loads(line) for line in stream if line.strip()]
    scenarios = {name: {row["scenario"] for row in rows} for name, rows in records.items()}
    tasks = {row["scenario"]: row["tasks"] for row in records["gen_tasks"]}
    splits = {}
    keys = {}
    for split in ("train", "test"):
        rows = pq.read_table(data / f"verl/{split}.parquet").to_pylist()
        keys[split] = set()
        for row in rows:
            item = row["env_kwargs"]
            scenario, index = item["scenario"], item["task_idx"]
            assert item["task"] == tasks[scenario][index], (scenario, index)
            assert all(scenario in values for values in scenarios.values()), scenario
            keys[split].add((scenario, index))
        assert len(keys[split]) == len(rows), f"duplicate {split} task"
        splits[split] = rows
    assert not keys["train"] & keys["test"], "train/test overlap"
    assert len(keys["train"] | keys["test"]) == sum(len(t) for t in tasks.values())
    model = Path(config.actor_rollout_ref.model.path)
    for filename in ("config.json", "tokenizer.json", "tokenizer_config.json"):
        if not (model / filename).is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(model / filename)
    if not list(model.glob("*.safetensors")) and not list(model.glob("pytorch_model*.bin")):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Model weights not found in {model}")
    if not Path(config.env.awm.python).is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(config.env.awm.python)
    return splits, {"split_rows": {k: len(v) for k, v in splits.items()},
                    "scenario_counts": {k: len(v) for k, v in scenarios.items()},
                    "task_alignment": "passed", "train_test_overlap": 0,
                    "model_config_and_weights_present": True}


def smoke(config, output, splits):
    # Load the packaged environment directly, without importing unrelated envs.
    path = ROOT / "idea_source/agent_system/environments/env_package/awm/envs.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("packaged_awm_env", path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    selected = []
    seen = set()
    for rows in (splits["train"], splits["test"], splits["train"][1:]):
        for row in rows:
            item = row["env_kwargs"]
            if item["scenario"] not in seen:
                selected.append(item)
                seen.add(item["scenario"])
                break
    env = module.AWMMCPVectorEnv(len(selected), 1, config.env)
    try:
        tasks, _ = env.reset(selected)
        observations, _, dones, infos = env.step([{"name": "list_tools", "arguments": None}] * len(selected))
        for item, observation, done, info in zip(selected, observations, dones, infos):
            if done or info.get("reward_type") == "environment_error":
                raise RuntimeError(f"Environment startup failed: {item['scenario']}: {info}")
            assert observation, "empty tool listing"
        _, rewards, dones, infos = env.step([{"name": "final", "content": "Smoke test, no task actions performed."}] * len(selected))
        assert all(dones), "final action did not terminate"
        for item, info in zip(selected, infos):
            if info.get("reward_type") in {"environment_error", "judge_error", "server_error"}:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Verifier failed: {item['scenario']}: {info}")
        return [{"scenario": item["scenario"], "task_idx": item["task_idx"],
                 "reset": bool(task), "list_tools": "passed", "final": "passed",
                 "reward": reward, "reward_type": info.get("reward_type")}
                for item, task, reward, info in zip(selected, tasks, rewards, infos)]
    finally:
        env.close()


def main():
    defaults = runtime_defaults()
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--model-path", default=os.environ.get("MODEL_PATH", defaults.get("model_path", "locaszzz/IDEA_sft")))
    parser.add_argument("--model-revision", default=os.environ.get("MODEL_REVISION", defaults.get("model_revision")))
    parser.add_argument("--dataset-revision", default=os.environ.get("DATASET_REVISION", defaults.get("dataset_revision")))
    parser.add_argument("--dataset-repo", default="locaszzz/IDEA_training_data")
    parser.add_argument("--download-data", action="store_true", help="Fetch RL/runtime inputs from the Hub dataset if absent; authenticate only if required")
    parser.add_argument("--awm-python", default=os.environ.get("AWM_PYTHON", defaults.get("awm_python", "/opt/awm/bin/python")))
    parser.add_argument("--output", default=str(ROOT / "reproduction" / datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")))
    parser.add_argument("--smoke", action="store_true", help="Test MCP startup, list_tools, and code verifier; no model inference")
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--train", action="store_true", help="Launch the recorded 200-step issue configuration; requires 8 free 80GB GPUs")
    mode.add_argument("--config-only", action="store_true", help="Also check Hydra composition without starting Ray or training")
    args, overrides = parser.parse_known_args()
    if overrides and not (args.train or args.config_only):
        parser.error("Hydra overrides require --train or --config-only")
    if args.download_data:
        download_data(args.dataset_repo, args.dataset_revision)
    if not Path(args.awm_python).is_file():
        parser.error("Set AWM_PYTHON or configure runtime.local.json with the separate AWM interpreter")
    config, output = prepare(args)
    splits, report = check(config)
    report["python"] = sys.executable
    report["scope"] = "input checks; NOT a completed training run"
    if args.smoke:
        report["environment_smoke"] = smoke(config, output, splits)
        import verl.workers.fsdp_workers as workers
        tests = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / "idea_source/tests/test_awm_projection.py"))
        names = [name for name in tests if name.startswith("test_")]
        for name in names:
            tests[name]()
        report["fsdp_workers_import"] = str(Path(workers.__file__).relative_to(ROOT))
        report["projection_tests_passed"] = len(names)
    (output / "checks.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2), flush=True)
    if args.train or args.config_only:
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["PYTHONPATH"] = str(ROOT / "idea_source")
        env["PATH"] = f"{Path(sys.executable).parent}:{env.get('PATH', '')}"
        env.setdefault("WANDB_MODE", "offline")
        env["WANDB_DIR"] = str(output)
        env.setdefault("TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM", "false")

"""JSON-lines bridge to Agent World Model's Python 3.12 MCP runtime."""

import asyncio
import json
import os
import shutil
